BP- 2014 -006

v.
FINAL ORDER ACCEPTING
HILLSBOROUGH AREA REGIONAL SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT
:
TRANSIT AUTHORITY,
Order Number: 15U -239
Date Issued: August 3, 2015
Respondent.
Tobe M. Lev, Orlando, attorney representing Local 1593.
Mark E. Levitt, Winter Park, attorney representing HARTA.
On July 30, 2015, the parties filed an agreement to settle these cases. On
July 31, the hearing officer issued his order recommending that the Commission accept
the agreement and close these cases. Upon consideration, the Commission hereby
accepts the parties' settlement agreement and incorporates it as a part of this final order.
Enforcement of this order shall be pursuant to Sections 120.69 and 447.5035, Florida
Statutes (2014). Accordingly, these cases are CLOSED.
This order may be appealed to the appropriate district court of appeal. A notice of
appeal must be received by the Commission and the district court of appeal within thirty
days from the date of this order. Except in cases of indigency, the court will require a
filing fee and the Commission will require payment for preparing the record on appeal.
Further explanation of the right to appeal is provided in Sections 120.68 and 447.504,
Florida Statutes (2014), and the Florida Rules of Appellate Procedure.

It is so ordered.
DELGADO and POOLE, Commissioners, concur.

HEARING OFFICER'S
HILLSBOROUGH AREA REGIONAL RECOMMENDED ORDER
:
TRANSIT AUTHORITY,
Respondent.
Tobe M. Lev, Orlando, attorney representing Local 1593.
Mark E. Levitt, Winter Park, attorney representing HARTA.
SHOWALTER, Hearing Officer.
On July 30, 2015, the Charging Party filed a notice of settlement of both the back
pay case and attorney's fees case. The settlement agreement was attached to the
notice and includes the amounts the Respondent will pay to the Charging Party and the
affected employees. Upon consideration, it appears that the settlement agreement
resolves all outstanding issues raised by these cases. Accordingly, I transfer these
cases to the Commission with the recommendation that the Commission accept the
agreement, order compliance with it, and close these cases. The parties have waived
the filing of exceptions to this recommended order.
ISSUED and SUBMITTED to the Public Employees Relations Commission in
accordance with Florida Administrative Code Rule 28- 106.216 and SERVED on all
